question: Should Slacrawl adopt `slacrawl-provider-v1`, `[[providers]]`, and numeric provider source ranks as supported core extension contracts?
rationale: The branch is technically substantial, but code review cannot decide whether this new protocol and configuration surface should become a long-lived compatibility commitment in core.

options.title: Approve after proof
options.body: Approve the contract direction, then require rebase, changelog cleanup, and redacted live import/resume/search plus v5-to-v6 upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Keep experimental
options.body: Keep the PR in draft or narrow it to a design document until versioning, compatibility, and provider-distribution expectations are settled.

options.title: Decline core contract
options.body: Close the core implementation and retain source-specific archive adapters outside Slacrawl unless a smaller stable extension boundary is agreed.

recommendation.title: Approve after proof
